scoring_justification: The Monte Carlo simulation cannot be recomputed in the verifier; we verify reported ITC values against paper-reported trends and structural consistency.

outputs.description: Computed lattice thermal conductivity of GaN and SiC at 300 K for phonon property validation.

CSV file containing simulated interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) values for different defect configurations. Columns: defect_concentration (float), defect_location (string: 'GaN', 'SiC', 'none'), heat_flux (float, W/m²), temperature_drop (float, K), itc (float, W/m²K).

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the reported bulk thermal conductivity against reference values with tolerance, and for the ITC CSV it will verify the itc = heat_flux / temperature_drop consistency, the monotonic trend (decreasing for GaN defects, increasing for SiC defects), and the percent change at concentration 0.05 compared to the defect-free case.

steps.description: Check bulk thermal conductivity of GaN and SiC within tolerance of paper reference values.
Check ITC trend with defects: self-consistency, monotonic correlation, and percent change at highest concentration.
